data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'blume' meaning 'flower'. Blinny is a diminutive form and could be seen as a pet name or a nickname for a girl named Blossom. The name Blinny carries the meaning “Little Blossom” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Blinny usually hope their child will grow to embody little blossom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
